primaryTextVariants.text: We cut an enterprise SaaS company's AWS bill by 68.4% in 30 days without dropping a single connection. The secret wasn't negotiating discounts—it was migrating idle EC2 compute to Graviton3 ARM64 serverless microservices and edge caching.

Most CTOs accept massive AWS bills because their teams size compute clusters for peak Monday morning traffic. But servers that sit idle at 6% CPU utilization between 11 PM and 6 AM cost you thousands every month.

By decomposing stateful clusters to event-driven Graviton3 Lambdas and single-table DynamoDB, we eliminated 68% of cloud waste while driving global edge TTFB under 120ms.

Read our complete architectural blueprint and download the CloudFormation templates.

When their AWS bill hit $14,000/mo, leadership demanded a 40% reduction within a quarter.

Rather than rationing engineer compute, we re-architected their workload to event-driven Graviton3 serverless microservices. By pushing 92% of dynamic read queries to CloudFront L2 edge cache and replacing connection-starved relational pools with DynamoDB single-table hashing, the bill collapsed by 68.4% in 30 days.

Explore the open case study and request a zero-cost architecture review.
